exposure: Use of unfractionated heparin (UFH) during childbirth
Use of low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) during childbirth
Women with obstetric disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC)
outcome: Critical obstetric bleeding requiring massive red blood cell transfusion ≥4,000 cc
cohort: 354,299 women with childbirth in Japan between 2018 and 2022
finding: Use of UFH during childbirth was significantly associated with an increased risk of critical obstetric hemorrhage requiring massive RBC transfusion or total hysterectomy, while use of LMWH was not.
